title: Recover a remote AstrBot deployment when NapCat is alive but the QQ upstream session is stale
steps: Verify RAG infrastructure and Gateway readiness
Verify the AstrBot OneBot adapter independently from the QQ upstream session
Detect a stale upstream session even when local containers and OneBot remain running
Snapshot service identities and restart only NapCat
Re-run full verification or stop with an explicit QR-login-required result
Expose a time-limited Tailscale-only UI when human login is required
Close the temporary UI and record only redacted outcome metadata
